scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/worker typecheck && bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.contracts:sync-env: bun -e 'const m = await Bun.file("apps/contracts/deployments/localhost.json").json(); let env = await Bun.file(".env").text(); const set = (k, v) => { const re = new RegExp(`^${k}=.*$`, "m"); env = re.test(env) ? env.replace(re, `${k}=${v}`) : `${env.trimEnd()}\n${k}=${v}\n`; }; set("ESCROW_ADDRESS", `"${m.address}"`); set("ESCROW_CONTRACT_ADDRESS", m.address); set("ESCROW_DEPLOY_BLOCK", String(m.deployBlock)); await Bun.write(".env", env); console.log("Synced .env with localhost.json:", m.address);'
